title: Is Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker Worth Playing? Honest Look
subtitle: What is free, what is for sale, and who will enjoy it.
description: Is Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker worth playing? An honest look at the free game, the optional store, ads, 12 languages and who this idle clicker suits.
card: An honest developer review of Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker, what is free, what the store sells and who should skip it.

faq.q: Do I need to buy anything to play Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker?
faq.a: No. The core game, including prestige, energy, artifacts, research and challenges, is playable without buying anything. The store offers shortcuts and cosmetics that make progress faster.
The ads in the game are rewarded: you choose to watch one to claim a bonus, such as a boost or extra offline earnings. Nothing in the core game requires you to watch ads to progress.

faq.q: Does Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker work offline?
faq.a: Your rigs keep earning while the app is closed, and you can collect up to 12 hours of income when you return. The Offline Vault and the Whale Card raise that cap to 24 hours.
